decisions.reason: Using GreenLatinos brand colors and fonts does not change the requirement to incorporate supplied photos into the final draft.
The branding choice is owned by the branding requirement; the same-message layout event already captures the independently stated straightforward approach, single pass, and full-document treatment.
The branding choice does not alter which proposal tables or budget materials must be incorporated.
The branding choice does not alter the current requirement to incorporate the organization chart into the final draft.
The selected brand colors and fonts do not change the requirement to deliver a print-ready PDF.
The branding choice affects visual identity but does not change the requirement to include the supplied narrative content.
The branding choice neither changes nor removes the previously stated target of no more than approximately 20 pages.
